en.text: Ah, good, come and look at this: the drive core, and the heat shield around it. It's what keeps us alive when we fly closer to the star.
en.description: Clone of ostra1/kade/qwen3_s2.flac (Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign, seed 2): A broad-shouldered man in his early fifties, the depot master of an orbital colony station, talking to a prospecting crew across the supply depot's counter. Solid, slightly rough baritone voice, lower mid-range, not deep or gravelly. Gruff but fair, organized and matter-of-fact, a man who keeps the books and knows every crate; friendly in a plain, unhurried way, never loud. Plain and conversational rather than narrating. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Ah, gut, komm und sieh dir das an: der Antriebskern und der Hitzeschild darum. Er hält uns am Leben, wenn wir näher an den Stern heranfliegen.
de.description: A tall man of about fifty, the engineer of a mining ship and a scientist who came out to study a restless star, showing a crew member the drive core in the engine room. Warm, resonant baritone voice, articulate and precise, with a teacher's patience. Proud of his work and absorbed in it, a quiet enthusiasm when he explains something, never loud. Plain and conversational rather than narrating. Native German speaker with a neutral accent.
